by: LineageOS, from Qualcomm's GPL audio techpack
takes: Bring-up: supplies, a reset pulse, 5 ms for enumeration, then bind; the reset is touched only at bind and on DSP restart; nothing in headset detection touches reset, supplies or SoundWire. Insertion debounce 256 ms (mainline uses less).

title: modem/tqftpserv: upgrade and add patches for rsize & seek option handling (pmaports !4747)
takes: A modem's file transfers with rsize and seek options need a tqftpserv that handles them; it made the modem work on two close Qualcomm phones (sm6350, qcm6490).

title: Xiaomi's GPL kernel for surya: the WCD937x node
takes: Supplies: L10A rxtx and px and BOB mic bias always on, L15A buck only on demand; micbias 1-3 at 2.7 V; a plain 3.5 mm jack with both MBHC switches set (hphl-swh, gnd-swh), no USB-C audio switch.

title: Xiaomi's GPL kernel for surya: the LPASS pin states
takes: The SoundWire pins' functions (TX data1 gpio19 func3, data2 gpio20 func2, RX data gpio22/23 func2) - mainline's corrected table agrees; the WCD937x reset is gpio24, active state driven high, sleep state low.

title: LineageOS sm6150 kernel: the vendor bolero codec (tx-macro, va-macro, bolero-cdc) and sm6150 machine driver
author: Qualcomm
takes: sm6150/sdmmagpie use qcom,va-without-decimation: the VA block gives only MCLK, the fs counter and DMIC clocks, clocked from the TX macro's MCLK through bolero's mclk mux; TX decimators record everything; TX AIF1 is TX_CDC_DMA_TX_3 (AFE 45111 = 0xB037)

title: sm7125-mainline/alsa-ucm-conf: miatoll HiFi (TX macro, TX_CODEC_DMA_TX_3 mic entries)
takes: SM7125 records through the TX macro on TX_CODEC_DMA_TX_3 with q6afe and WCD937x; its TX controller has no dout port, so <&swr2 0> is right there - the template sm7150 copied. Whether miatoll's mic records is unverified

title: postmarketOS wiki: Qualcomm Snapdragon 730/730G/732G (SM7150)

takes: Upstream QCS615 audio (merged 2026-05) is AudioReach with an external DA7212 over MI2S, headset mic only: no LPASS macro, WCD or DMIC work for talos yet

title: [PATCH v3 00/12] qrb4210-rb2: wsa audio playback and capture (Alexey Klimov, Linaro)
author: Alexey Klimov
takes: SM6115/QRB4210 records its DMIC through the VA macro on VA_CODEC_DMA_TX_0 with the DCODEC vote on q6afe - both refused by surya's ADSP, so not a template for SM7150

title: pulpoff/linux-surya: mainline 7.2.15 for the POCO X3 NFC on Mobian, both microphones and call audio
author: pulpoff
takes: surya's microphones are analog on the WCD9375 (bottom AMIC1 on ADC1, top AMIC3 on ADC2); capture link on <&swr2 1>; qcom,tx-port-mapping <2 3 4 5> gives ADC2 its own master port 3; LPI gpio7-11 NC (no DMIC pins in use); q6voice call uplink needs a running mono capture on TX_CODEC_DMA_TX_3

title: sm7150-mainline/linux PR 60: working WCD9375 microphone capture on davinci (open)
author: artemkaVG
takes: The four faults of SM7150 WCD capture: swr_tx_data mux 3, the TX bus wakeup IRQ, port numbering shifted by the TX controller's one dout port, and the capture link's DAI 1; plus MultiMedia2 for capture. The place to contribute surya's fixes upstream, beside it rather than in a parallel series

title: Xiaomi's GPL kernel (surya-q-oss): sdmmagpie-qrd-overlay.dts, the sound card routing Xiaomi kept from Qualcomm's QRD board
author: Qualcomm/Xiaomi
takes: Declares TX DMIC1-3 (bias 1/3) and AMIC2 together with TX SWR_ADC0/ADC2 from ADC1/ADC2: a reference board's routing, not proof of DMICs on surya; every TX/RX path is routed to VA_MCLK

title: qcom-sm7150 (xiaomi-surya) unable to unlock sim: QMI protocol error (3) - root cause tqftpserv 1.1.1 (pmaports #4441)
takes: tqftpserv 1.1.1 never writes the modem's short state files, so the modem stays in shutting-down and the SIM reads as missing; fixed in tqftpserv 1.2 (9ef11c0). On surya the SIM works in slot 2.
